title: micranthemum orbiculatum var. emarginatum
intro: Micranthemum orbiculatum var. emarginatum, commonly known as the Dwarf Ludwigsia or Dwarf Pickerelweed, is a flowering plant species native to North America. As an herb, it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing irritated mucous membranes, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Micranthemum orbiculatum var. emarginatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
